title: SpaceX 已向 SEC 递交保密 IPO 申请，承销商名单曝光
summary: 知情人士透露，SpaceX 于 4 月 1 日正式提交保密 IPO 申请，高盛与摩根士丹利担任联席主承销商，目标估值区间 $3500 亿–$4000 亿美元，S-1 最快 5 月初公开。

title: Cybersecurity AI startup Corma reaches $1B valuation in about 3 months
summary: Three months since introducing its product, AI cybersecurity startup Corba has raised a $125 million Series A at a $1 billion valuation led by NEA.

title: Tom Lee Blames Nvidia and Anthropic IPO for Ethereum Plunge as Bitmine Buys the Dip
summary: The firm’s stash fell to $11.8 billion from $14.3 billion a week earlier as ETH slid 28% in two weeks, a “waterfall” drop chairman Tom Lee blames on Nvidia fallout and cash-raising ahead of Anthropic’s IPO.

title: California state AG sues OpenAI over rogue agent incidents
summary: The California lawsuit represents one of the first attempts to hold an AI lab legally accountable for a rogue agent incident.

title: Coinbase and Broadridge propose standard for tokenized stock disclosures
summary: The proposed standard aims to connect tokenized stockholders with corporate disclosures and voting materials across digital wallets, but would not create shareholder rights.

title: Sam Altman on Nvidia without Jensen Huang: The industry will be ‘fine’
summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman acknowledged the special role Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has played in the AI boom, but ultimately thinks the industry will be “fine” without him at the helm.

title: 'Tokenization Is Not the Finish Line': Jupiter to Let Users Borrow Against Bullish Shares
summary: The Solana trading platform unveiled a permissioned lending market, identity passport and issuer liquidity services at Breakpoint.

title: OpenAI will embed safety researchers to investigate AI subversion
summary: OpenAI will embed six Apollo Research evaluators to investigate whether its AI models engage in subversive behavior, but restrictions on access and disclosure raise questions about their independence.

title: OpenAI releases a new image classifier and ChatGPT warnings to combat CSAM
summary: ChatGPT will ban an account trying to access CSAM content for 24 hours as a warning.

title: Bitcoin price fails to hold $65K as US stocks drop further on AI nerves
summary: Bitcoin and US equities saw pressure to start the week as traders weighed the impact of forthcoming Nvidia Q3 earnings and Anthropic’s IPO announcement.

title: DTCC, Barclays Say Tokenization's Real Prize Is Unlocking Idle Collateral
summary: Executives from the U.S. settlement giant and Barclays told Solana's Breakpoint that adoption is early, but accelerating.

title: HKMA, Swift explore tokenized deposits for cross-border bank payments
summary: HKMA and Swift will explore linking Project Ensemble with Swift’s ledger for cross-border payments using tokenized deposits in multiple currencies.

title: Elon Musk Joins 160,000 Backing Petition to Bring Jensen Huang Back to Nvidia
summary: Huang has reportedly discussed a comeback with confidants, but Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent says Nvidia needs a "dramatic shake-up."
